title: Write authority
summary: Lane inspection permits chained read-only Git calls, simple file reads and directory changes. File reads include nl; test and [ predicates also qualify as reads. Every segment is checked; mixed writes, redirects and command substitutions retain ordinary lane authority. Inline sed/awk programs are data, while input and script files remain path operands. Git calls with environment assignment prefixes or global -c, --config-env or --exec-path options do not qualify as reads; ordinary status and calls using -C or --git-dir still qualify. Configuration options remain parsed for write-target detection.
